hook_description: A phone displaying a talking pigeon filter video is held near a sleeping person's head.
first_2_seconds_description: A smartphone screen shows a talking pigeon filter image moving closer to a person sleeping in bed.
scene_summary: A person wakes up their sleeping friend by placing a phone playing a weird talking pigeon filter video right against their head.
text_overlay_summary: Text states 'Arkadaşımı böyle uyandırdım' (I woke up my friend like this).
spoken_dialogue_summary: Turkish voiceover plays from the phone audio, prompting a confused 'Alo?' from the friend.
trend_mechanic: Using funny or surreal audio filter videos to wake up sleeping friends.
